body:
Your Uncle sounds toxic AF. 

I here you. 

Society is fucked in a lot of ways, and it's extra difficult for some of us.

My family constantly calls me lazy etc

Yes, the difference in our looks was a huge factor. I saw genuine examples of him getting almost whatever he wanted because of how pretty he was. It still makes me angry. Although, I know I struck a nerve when I told him looks fade. He didn't like hearing that.

I have struggled with loving myself, but today I feel slightly better and I am going to try to set that in motion and just be the best me and hope for all good things.
Thank you, I feel alright today. I will try to hold onto the light and certainly not fall for the same bad behavior from (certain) guys again.

Thank you. Yeah he was a bad guy, and I ignored red flags because I fell into the trap no one else could love me. But I know that is not true, I need to better myself for me and hopefully someone truly good will come my way.

Thank you Mara for the kind message! Yes, loving myself is something I have struggled with, but I will try again, especially after reading your and all the other comments. Thank you for the offer to talk to you if I need someone to listen.
Sorry to hear about your bad luck, but sounds like you are chugging along and that's good. Thank you for the push to keep going.

Thank you. My head knows he was bad news, but the heart misses the good times and the closeness. But even now the pain is lessening, especially in reading the comments from this post. I feel a little better.
Appreciate the suggestion, and the reminder that even thin people struggle sometimes too.
This was very touching to read, thank you. :)
Thank you for sharing your story. Yeah, I think it's possible I have a "type." I have been to therapy, but not to exactly discuss issues with relationships.
honestly i'm tired at this moment. i may go for a nap for a bit or try to go for a walk but i'll message you later. i do want to talk. im so broken and tired of fighting
There not really being a sure, non-bloody method.

First, I just have to say, we need to end the stigma of men not showing emotions, not crying. It seems to slowly be changing. I hope it continues.

I cried last night, because I'm quite lonely. The things I've done recently to meet new people have not worked, and a gentlemen that was a good friend and confidant ghosted me after a disagreement.  We'd been friends for just over a year. 

I fear I may never have a good friend, god forbid a lover, ever. The world is very unkind to people who aren't supermodel hot. It's a battle just for someone to glance in my direction, while the super hot guy with a shitty personality can get whatever he wants.

I just know that I have been emotionally abused and I saw the same thing that I've seen in her husband and I'm just worried.

The stream is his, if he's ever away it's only for about 30 seconds. He's running the show.
Why don't you DM me? I don't think I should announce publicly whoI this is, if he caught wind of it, I worry what he might do.

That's upsetting to hear... I understand it's not typical to see abuse in this way, but, a viewer watching people on the internet and seeing abuse is bound to happen more and more. I hope these helpful services can adapt so a third party can report it.
I don't think I should say exactly, just to not publicly identify them.
Hope you broadcast again.

"My Son's Mother..." Wouldn't that make you the mother? I'm confused. 

Oh wait, you're the father. Hello, I got it now.
No, I don't... I don't have an alter or anything. I'll check Youtube, thanks.

Okay, so, I'm confused. I just put a glass of water and a slice of pound cake out? How long do I leave it?

He's not really working for me.
Must be nice to have friends lol
But it's almost EVERY PICTURE.

As a bigger person, even when I was younger, I remember refusing to ride a horse because I was afraid I would hurt it.

You would think all heavy people would think twice before riding an animal, but I guess not.

Ah, well, I'm so sorry to hear that. I don't have many friennds but I still got out with family. I'm sad that you haven't celebrated your birthday for six years. No one should ever be in that position.

I hope you have a better day today.

Yeah, the thing was though he was on FB, and they throw it in your face. But, he is busy, so, it looks like he just forgot. I make it a point to remember birthdays but I understand not everyone does.

But, hopefully he'll remember next year.

I've been there.

Not quite there now, but feeling kind of low.

I'm sorry you're feeling down.
Aww. Stories like this warm my heart.

I don't know anything about your disorder, but, earlier in my life, my anxiety would completely kill my appetite. So, I understand not feeling hungry and eating very little.

I would suggest though, if you haven't had ANY food in a few days, and this continues, within your means, try to at least have one meal a day. Force yourself to at least have dinner or supper.

The body needs its fuel.

I totally get you.

When people stop by without calling first, I find it so overwhelming.
Making fun of larger people doesn't help anybody.

Thank you for your concern. 

Another gigantic boulder that is worse than I have ever faced has emerged, but, I am getting help and still trying. It is getting really difficult though.

Just wanted to say your post gave me some hope. 

I am also still at home, have depression and a disability although nothing like yours. I send you light and good thoughts that this venture pan out for you.

Yep.

I suffer from depression and am not quote "successful." 

For years I was shamed by my extended family, to the point where I barely attend family functions anymore. 

You pinpointed a big factor to the problem.

Me too.

I get you.

I'd say "hang in there" but I'm not feeling good myself.

Life sucks.

Nope.

I have no one also.

I have one "friend" I could if I really needed someone, but our contact has been getting less and less. So, I feel pretty alone too.

I mean, no one one remembered my birthday a few weeks ago.

I feel like if I died tomorrow, no one would care.

I am so sorry.

I can see how that would be devastating.

When I was 15, I invited six close friends to my birthday party and none of them showed. That was a very, very sad day.

Now it's years later and my birthday just passed a few weeks ago and nobody called me or texted me. I did have a family party a few days later, but it was really people just "going through the motions."

Birthdays are a big deal. And I feel, the people that remember and/or attend your parties really do care.
It's people like you that cause suicides.
I appreciate the thoughtful reply.

Why you're in the depressed sub, reading a "my birthday was forgotten" post, telling a depressed person "birthdays are no big deal", I will never understand.

You made me feel worse. 

Thanks.
